rubric.rubric_intent: Evaluate a preprint paper for epistemic accountability and hygiene by assessing its self-reported claims and citation verification.

dimensions.name: Numeric Claim Verification
dimensions.description: Measures the accuracy of numeric claims made in the paper by verifying them against cited sources or supplementary materials.
dimensions.evidence_instructions: Examine the 'Numeric claims' table in the audit, checking each claim against the provided 'Source pointer' and 'Verified value'. Note instances of mismatch or lack of verification.

dimensions.name: Citation Abstract Alignment
dimensions.description: Assesses whether the cited abstracts accurately reflect the content they are meant to support.
dimensions.evidence_instructions: Consult the 'Citation pointers' table and verify each cited abstract excerpt against the actual arXiv abstract from the stated ID. Note discrepancies or misrepresentations.

dimensions.name: Rubric Self-Application Fidelity
dimensions.description: Evaluates the consistency and thoroughness with which the paper applies the META-RUBRIC to itself.
dimensions.evidence_instructions: Examine the self-application results (e.g., scores on different dimensions) and look for any contradictions, omissions, or inconsistencies in the self-grading process.  Note if the paper acknowledges its own limitations.

dimensions.name: Failure Mode Taxonomy Depth
dimensions.description: Determines if the failure mode taxonomy is sufficiently detailed and insightful to capture relevant issues.
dimensions.evidence_instructions: Review the description of the '24 distinct modes' and assess if they adequately represent potential pitfalls in rubric-based LLM evaluation. Assess whether these modes seem grounded in specific incidents.

dimensions.name: Evidence-Gate Enforcement Clarity
dimensions.description: Evaluates the explicitness of the criteria and mechanisms used for evidence-gated scoring within the framework.
dimensions.evidence_instructions: Examine the description of “evidence-gate enforcement” and assess if the procedures for incorporating evidence into the scoring process are clearly defined and consistently applied within the document.

dimensions.name: Calibration Dataset Representativeness
dimensions.description: Checks if the calibration dataset accurately represents the range of scenarios and biases encountered in LLM evaluation.
dimensions.evidence_instructions: Review the description of the calibration dataset and investigate whether the included cases are diverse and relevant to the types of failures the META-RUBRIC aims to detect.

dimensions.name: Ablation Study Justification
dimensions.description: Assesses the clarity and validity of the rationale provided for the ablation study comparing 9b and 0.8b models.
dimensions.evidence_instructions: Analyze the description of the 9b vs 0.8b ablation and evaluate if the explanation for the observed differences (synonym usage) is well-supported and convincing. Does the paper adequately acknowledge potential confounding factors?

inputs.intent: audit this paper for epistemic accountability and hygiene

receipt.reproducibility_note: Same inputs + same backend + same model version + same rubric_hash should produce scores within ±1 point. A rubric_hash diff between runs means the measuring stick itself changed — scores are not directly comparable.

meta_policy.rationale: For preprint papers the ground truth is the prose itself. The hardcoded cap-at-6 for README/doc citations is a software-repo heuristic that mis-scores papers. Window expanded to 80k bytes so a 30-80k paper is not silently truncated.
